evidence.summary: Exact real Automation build/execution receipts, resident routing fixtures and warm selection measurements.

summary: Recoverable CAS-safe Environment selection index reduces unchanged entry from 10 to 4 high-level Store reads and approximately 2.2 to 1.7 seconds while retaining zero Git/native/process launches and Store writes. Store admission cost remains; resident boundaries currently reopen Store and consume feed/LS cursors through the same router. This does not resolve all continuous supervisor startup latency.
